run_boost_build_test_explicit: run a BoostBuild test that verifies the explicit directive builds only specified targets
test_boostbuild_tester_write: test the BoostBuild Tester write method to create jamroot.jam and source files for build tests
test_boostbuild_tester_run_build_system: test the BoostBuild Tester run_build_system method to execute builds with optional target arguments
test_boostbuild_tester_expect_addition: test the BoostBuild Tester expect_addition method to verify expected build output files were created
test_boostbuild_tester_cleanup: test the BoostBuild Tester cleanup method to remove all test artifacts after test completion
